theorems.name: Submission.bv_lintegral_finite_net_of_lipschitz_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsCompact Q → (∀ k, IntegrableOn (u k) Q volume) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (B Λ : ℝ) (w : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ Q, |w k x| ≤ B) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ Q, |w k x - w k y| ≤ Λ * ‖x - y‖) ∧ ∀ k, (∫⁻ x in Q, ‖u k x - w k x‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ j ∈ F, (∫⁻ x in Q, ‖u k x - u j x‖ₑ) < ENNReal.ofReal ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
